events.what: Pasten, 'Improved bounds for Szpiro's conjecture': unconditional log|Δ| ≪ N log log N for all elliptic curves over Q, and log|Δ| ≪ N for semistable curves
Self-published Zenodo item claiming a full proof of Szpiro's conjecture via a 'CronNet-Holo framework'
events.credibility_reason: Landmark problem (equivalent in strength to a form of abc) claimed in an ungated repository; author has self-published dozens of 'CronNet-Holo' items across unrelated fields (Riemann Hypothesis, cosmology, crop circles); no affiliation, no uptake; the September 2026 Pasten paper on the same quantity treats the conjecture as open.

judgement.doubts: The semistable result log|Δ| ≪ N is still a bound on a class, not the conjectured (6+ε)log N inequality for that class, so it is not a case settlement. The Pasten PDF full text was not readable; absence of AI disclosure is inferred from the abstract page only.
